name: Mittal Palms
address: Survey Nos. 31, 32 and 33, Shivanahalli Village, Jakkur Hobli, next to The HDFC School, Bengaluru, Karnataka
description: Mittal Palms offers two- and three-bedroom apartments in the Jakkur-Shivanahalli area. The project's published brochure presents a residential setting with landscaped grounds and a lake-oriented outlook. Its location and apartment formats give buyers a clear starting point, while the condition, outlook and documentation of the particular home should determine the final comparison.

content.faqsTitle: Six things to know about Mittal Palms

faqs.question: Where exactly is Mittal Palms located?
faqs.answer: Survey Nos. 31, 32 and 33, Shivanahalli Village, Jakkur Hobli, next to The HDFC School, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 560064. The Google Maps link uses this project and address.

faqs.question: What configurations and sizes are documented?
faqs.answer: Block A, Block B, Block C, Block D, Block E, Block F, Block G. Documented saleable/super built-up plan areas span 1180–1950 sq ft. The layout table identifies each area basis and applicable phase.

faqs.question: What is the published starting price?
faqs.answer: ₹88.17 L–₹1.01 Cr* Onward. The pricing record identifies the source and quoted configuration. Unpriced formats are excluded from the reference range; a current cost sheet is needed for the selected unit. Applicable charges are itemised separately by the source.

faqs.question: What is the status and possession timeline?
faqs.answer: Ready to move. Published timeline: Ready to move; secondary registry completion August 2020. This is a published schedule/status reference, not a fresh contractual handover confirmation.

faqs.question: What are the main amenities?
faqs.answer: Children’s play area, Entrance lobby, Solar lighting, Swimming pool, Lifts, Landscaped gardens. 20+ amenities advertised on Housing; supplied brochure should govern delivery. These are published facilities; confirm which are completed and accessible to your selected phase.

faqs.question: What makes this project worth comparing?
faqs.answer: Two and three bedroom apartment formats Jakkur Shivanahalli location Landscaped residential setting. Aaramv can compare these features with your space needs, budget and daily routes, and help coordinate the next steps through move-in.
